neighbours.label: The word piece just before a 'g' continuation inside a name: 'are' in 'Tuareg' (and 'ia' in 'Hoodia' before 'gordonii'); the output direction predicts g-initial tokens

Many silver crosses sold in Agadez are made by Tuareg craftsmen.
Supplements made from Hoodia gordonii are sold as appetite suppressants.

notes: Card: 'are' x7 in Tuareg, Hood|ia; reversed output promotes ' g', 'g', 'ge', 'gh', 'gs'. Probes: Tuareg 0.99 and 1.03, Hoodia gordonii 0.81; Berber 0.05, Afghanistan 0.01, Stalingrad 0.01, Pittsburgh 0.00, Investment Group 0.19.
